tests.title: Hidden products are absent from storefront category listings
tests.goal: A hidden product remains active in CRM but is not publicly discoverable in the storefront catalog.
preconditions: The staging CRM has an active Hidden Product available.
data: Name of an existing active Hidden Product; do not change it.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and identify an active product whose visibility is Hidden Product.
Open Visit my online store in a separate tab.
Search the storefront for the exact product name and browse its relevant category.

expected.text: The active product remains present in the CRM with Hidden Product visibility.
The exact product is not shown in storefront search or category results.
